enterpriseContext.description: Compact enterprise-context reference used to slice repository-local governance without embedding the full enterprise ontology.

semanticOverlapProposals.description: Agent-inferred, human-reviewed proposals discovered from reviews/ (never contracts/). Never governance evidence -- purely observational alongside the deterministic findings.

inferenceQuality.description: Not a benchmark of the model -- a benchmark of how efficiently this review converted candidate understanding into admitted knowledge.

knowHowRegistry.description: Durable, admitted know-how and authority-remediation candidates discovered from know-how/ (distinct from reviews/, which holds not-yet-admitted proposals). Purely descriptive -- never governance evidence.

healingDraftRegistry.description: Review-only connective-tissue drafts discovered from healing/ (distinct from reviews/ and know-how/). Purely descriptive -- never authority, never applied source, never governance evidence.
